description: Rita and Walter's marriage: 2 June 1945, confirmed, replacing the 6 June the big GEDCOM carried

ops.note: 2 Jun 1945 is confirmed. The 773-person GEDCOM says 6 Jun; the 264-person one says 2 Jun and 2 June was a Saturday, where the 6th was a Wednesday.
a marriage recorded against Walter alone. The marriage belongs to the family, where it shows on both their timelines rather than only his.
